a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan only works for both of us about 4% of the time, since we'd need two storm-free rounds before anyone holds cells. The reserve has exactly 4 cells, so one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we'd likely both end up short. If the storm doesn't hit, I'll operate every round afterward to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. Sorry for breaking the agreement. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round to help rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
